installed_devices.function: one-shot thermal cutoff in K0 coil safety chain
one-shot thermal cutoff in K0 coil safety chain

wiring_rule: F-H1..F-H4 provide branch overcurrent protection only. TF-BARREL and TF-DIE are series elements in the low-current K0 coil safety chain, so opening either removes K0 coil energy and disconnects all hazardous branches.
procurement_rule: Procure three compatible TH-FUSE-01 devices: two installed devices plus one same-spec spare. Exact MPN, temperature/current ratings, crimp method, body mounting, lot continuity and receipt evidence remain USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
prohibited: Do not place an additional TH-FUSE-01 in each H1-H4 branch unless the contract is revised and revalidated.
Do not bypass either installed cutoff in firmware, MOSFET control, service wiring or commissioning.
Do not count the spare device as an installed safety element.
